message.content:
To sign in to a **Microsoft account**, go to Microsoft’s account sign-in page, enter the email address or phone number associated with the account, and then enter your password.[1][5]

If you use a **work or school account**, Microsoft directs you to the **My Account** portal for managing the account, and if you cannot sign in you should use the work/school password reset option or contact your IT admin.[2]

If you are having trouble signing in, Microsoft says most sign-in issues can be identified with its **sign-in helper tool**, and you can also use **Contact Microsoft Support** for further help.[1]
